card.title: Invisible Hierarchy
card.instruction: Treat every interaction as evidence of an unseen hierarchy and keep identifying who truly outranks whom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everyone looked at the quiet man before approving the budget. He must run this place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's the electrician. The lights flickered.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the director waited for his nod. So he's above her.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's stopping the meeting to let him out. Can we please finish?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once she returns. Apparently even his departure outranks our budget.
